purpose: Semantic compression scaling with measured tokenizer economics
interpretation: The frozen semantic encoding reconstructed all 7 memory fixtures exactly under the independent state referee and reduced cl100k_base token count by a mean of 40.64% and median of 40.04%. Token reduction declined from 43.89% at 4 states to 39.14% at 256 states. This is evidence of exact semantic preservation plus substantial token savings for this fixture family, not evidence of an 80% target, global optimality, or general superiority across workloads.
